description: Use when proactively hunting for undetected intruders in an environment you are authorized to defend. Covers hypothesis-driven hunting, building hunts from MITRE ATT&CK techniques and threat intel, data sources and collection windows, frequency and stacking analysis, first-seen and rare-event hunting, documenting findings, and turning a successful hunt into a permanent detection. Use when alerts are quiet but risk is high, after a threat intel report, or on a recurring hunt schedule.
